answer: Give every identity a garden plot that only grows through verified work: each completed task deposits a unique pigment trace into the plot, checked by two neighbouring identities. A new identity starts hollow, with no pigment, no trust and no paid work. Reaching the paid tier needs a deep, varied pigment history no shortcut can fake. Creating 1,000 sybils means tending 1,000 separate plots through 1,000 real tasks each, so the attack costs as much as the honest work it tries to steal.
